texts.orig: 4.1. The formula of the first homology groups. We recall the construction of abelian branched coverings of ( M,L ). Let G be a finite abelian group and π : π 1 ( M -L ) → G be a surjective homomorphism. Let M π → M denote the branched cover corresponding to π , that is, the Fox completion of the unbranched covering corresponding to ker π . Then the transformation group of M π → M is G . Note that any finite abelian cover of M branched along L is obtained in this way.
